data.name: Jewel
data.gender_notes: Jewel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'jewel', meaning a precious gem or jewel. In the Bible, the term 'jewel' is used metaphorically to describe something of great worth or value. The name Jewel carries the meaning “Precious gem” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jewel usually hope their child will grow to embody precious gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine beauty and worth of an individual.
data.etymology: Jewel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Precious gem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jewel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: ג'ול
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'ול מקורו במילה העברית 'אבן', שפירושה אבן יקרה או תכשיט. הוא סמיל ליהלומים ואבנים יקרות אחרות, שמסמלות אור, יופי וערך רוחני. בשם זה משתמשים כיום לנשים, ומשמעותו היא אישה שמאירה ומבריקה כמו אבן יקרה.

in_greek.name: Τζέβελ
in_greek.meaning: Πολύτιμος λίθος, σύμβολο φωτός και ομορφιάς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζέβελ προέρχεται από την αγγλική λέξη 'jewel', που σημαίνει πολύτιμος λίθος ή κόσμημα. Στην πνευματική του σημασία, συμβολίζει το φως, την ομορφιά και την πνευματική αξία. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, τα ονόματα που σχετίζονται με πολύτιμους λίθους χρησιμοποιούνται συχνά για να εκφράσουν την πνευματική αξία και τη σχέση με το Θεό.

in_latin.name: Jewel
in_latin.meaning: pretiosus lapis, symbolum lucis et pulchritudinis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jewel originem habet in voce Anglica 'jewel', quae pretiosum lapidem seu ornamentum significat. In traditione Christiana, nomina quae cum pretiosis lapidibus coniunguntur, saepe adhibentur ad exprimendam spiritualem virtutem et connexionem cum Deo. Hoc nomen hodie pro feminis usurpatur, significans mulierem quae sicut pretiosus lapis lucet et splendet.

in_english.name: Jewel
in_english.meaning: a precious stone, symbolizing light, beauty, and spiritual value
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jewel originates from the Old French 'jewel', meaning a precious stone or ornament. It symbolizes light, beauty, and spiritual value, reflecting the wearer's inner radiance and preciousness in the eyes of God. Historically, jewel names have been used in Christian tradition to signify virtues and divine blessings. Today, Jewel is used as a given name for girls, implying a person of great spiritual worth and luminosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jewel carries a unique and captivating appeal in the English language. It highlights the connection to the natural world, evoking images of rare and beautiful gemstones. The name has been popular among celebrities and influencers, adding to its appeal and desirability in contemporary culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian theology, the name Jewel takes on a deeper meaning as a reflection of the value and worth placed on every human life by God. Just as a precious jewel is cherished and protected, each person is considered a priceless creation of God and worthy of love, respect, and protection. The name Jewel serves as a reminder of the inherent worth and dignity of every human being in the eyes of the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: A Jewel in Christianity represents purity, value, and rarity. Symbolizing the inner beauty and worth of a person in God's eyes.

historical_references.reference: The name Jewel was given to Queen Elizabeth I of England during her reign from 1558 to 1603. Her subjects bestowed this name upon her due to her inner beauty and the treasures of her realm.

Another Jewel was Saint Jewel, a sixth-century English nun and abbess. She was known for her virtuous life and her miraculous powers of healing. The name Jewel was given to her because she was considered a precious gem among her community.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jewel has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts, often associated with self-care, luxury goods, and personal branding. This name has become popular on social media platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, and blogging. On Instagram, accounts with the name Jewel often feature content related to self-care routines, skincare tips, and fashion. On YouTube, Jewel is a name for channels dedicated to makeup tutorials, lifestyle vlogs, and personal stories. In the realm of personal branding, the name Jewel is used by influencers and content creators to convey a sense of uniqueness, value, and beauty. The name is also commonly used in the marketing and branding of luxury goods, as it suggests rarity, preciousness, and exclusivity.
